BNB Chain56 direct DOOAR V2 Router02 only, not a generic aggregator or arbitrary executor. Current official beta swap app binds BSC router to this address and factory to 0x1e895bfe59e3a5103e8b7da3897d1f2391476f3c. Sourcify runtime and creation grades are exact_match; root is nonproxy with immutable factory/WETH. Dependencies/pairs/token runtime and financial safety are not separately attested.

Amounts use each token native base units, LP amounts use pair share units, and ABI ETH names mean native BNB here (wei,18 decimals); WETH is WBNB 0xbb4cdb9cbd36b01bd1cbaebf2de08d9173bc095c. Nonpayable calls require zero native value; payable swaps/addLiquidityETH use msg.value. Existing separate token or LP allowances may be required but none is granted here.

All token/LP funding is transferFrom(msg.sender), or caller native msg.value. Asset addresses/path identify tokens and deterministic factory pairs; output to is a financial receiver, not caller executable calldata. Router swaps always pass empty pair callback data. No backend signing, permit, role, bridge, flash-callback or opaque payload capability is introduced.

Exact-input swap outputs floor reserve formula; exact-output required inputs floor then add1. Library applies 99/100 input factor, a1% fee per hop, not ordinary Uniswap0.3%. Primary STEPN docs describe nominal split0.3%LP/0.6%ecosystem/0.1%development; that does not attest actual pair fee distribution. Deadline, caller amountOutMin or amountInMax/msg.value bound each corresponding swap; price impact, multi-hop fees, token taxes and reserve changes matter.

Liquidity addition chooses desired amounts for empty reserves, otherwise reserve ratio optimal amounts; source checks the optimized-side minimum on the chosen branch, not a universal independent check of both caller minima. LP is minted to chosen receiver with no min-LP parameter. addLiquidityETH refunds unused native BNB to msg.sender. Standard removal pulls caller LP, burns and checks reported token amounts against minima; native variant unwraps WBNB and pays receiver. LP bears inventory/impermanent-loss risk and pair mint/burn fees and rounding.

Fee-on-transfer token-to-token and native-to-token exact-input variants enforce receiver final balance increase; standard swap returned amounts may not represent tax-adjusted receiver receipt. Token-to-native supporting variant unwraps the entire router WBNB balance; fee-supporting native LP removal forwards entire router token balance and checks pair-reported token minimum before final taxed transfer, not receiver net receipt. Never prefund router or pairs or rely on residual balances as owned credit. No queue, custody account, guaranteed fill or future payout is created.

Native payouts/refunds are fixed empty-data BNB transfers and can fail for a receiver that rejects native currency. Unsupported token behavior, pair liquidity and dependency failures can revert. Current frontend and source binding do not guarantee any pair exists, continued maintenance, returns, backing or eligibility; unsupported-chain deployments and all permit variants are excluded.

> For the complete documentation index, see [llms.txt](https://whitepaper.stepn.com/llms.txt). Markdown versions of documentation pages are available by appending `.md` to page URLs; this page is available as [Markdown](https://whitepaper.stepn.com/other-modules/decentralized-exchange.md).

# Decentralized Exchange

STEPN has built its own multi-chain Decentralized Exchange (DEX) **DOOAR**, it will undergo a few stages as outlined below:

Stage 1: A STEPN in-app swap without an independent front end: the swap only serve users within the STEPN app

Stage 2: A DEX with a front end: anyone can provide liquidity to GST/USDC & GMT/USDC pairs.

Stage 3: A DEX with a front end: anyone can create liquidity pools for other tokens (MULTI-CHAIN).

The swap within STEPN will charge 1% trading fee. In this 1% fee: 

1. 0.3% will be rewarded to the liquidity providers.
2. 0.6% will be held at a separate address to give back to the STEPN ecosystem. The potential use cases include: a) GMT buyback and burn; b) NFT sneakers buyback and burn; c) Support ecosystem building events ; d) Community giveaways and raffles.
3. 0.1% will be used for the future development work. 

The contract address of **DOOAR** is: \
\
Solana: \
Dooar9JkhdZ7J3LHN3A7YCuoGRUggXhQaG4kijfLGU2j\
\
BNBChain: \
Factory: 0x1e895bFe59E3A5103e8B7dA3897d1F2391476f3c \
Router: 0x53e0e51b5Ed9202110D7Ecd637A4581db8b9879F

Ethereum:\
Factory: 0x1e895bFe59E3A5103e8B7dA3897d1F2391476f3c \
Router: 0x53e0e51b5Ed9202110D7Ecd637A4581db8b9879F

Polygon:

Router: 0xAcc8e414ceeCF0BBF438f6c4B7417Ca59dcF7E47\
\
Dooar is officially released on 17th August 2022, the DEX address is dooar.com
